messages.subject: KCE Electronics | Advanced manufacturing, ESG and stakeholder strategy
messages.body:
Dear KCE Electronics Leadership Team,

I am reaching out because KCE Electronics's Thailand platform aligns strongly with my experience leading regulated industrial, ESG and country stakeholder priorities.

I currently serve as Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department at AGM Inc., part of Zijin Mining Group. My responsibilities span government and regulatory relations, ESG, social performance, corporate coordination and executive stakeholder strategy.

I bring hands-on experience aligning ministries, regulators, communities, strategic partners and internal operating teams around complex investment and sustainability priorities. My recent work also includes large-scale solar and battery-storage transition support and carbon-data governance.

I would welcome consideration for Thailand or regional mandates across Corporate Affairs, Government Relations, Sustainability, Strategic Partnerships or country leadership. I have attached a KCE Electronics-focused executive CV.

Kind regards,
Ragunauth Ramsaroop
